title: Jacob and Esau
lines: This is Jacob, who was later called Israel.
這是雅各，他後來被稱為以色列。
Jacob was the father of twelve sons, who became the twelve tribes of Israel.
雅各有十二個兒子，他們成為以色列的十二支派。
Jacob had a twin brother named Esau.
雅各有個雙胞胎哥哥，名叫以掃。
Even when Jacob and Esau were in their mother's belly, they fought.
雅各和以掃還在母腹裡的時候，就彼此相爭。
As the boys grew up, Esau liked to be outside and to hunt, while Jacob was quiet and liked to stay home.
兩個孩子長大了，以掃喜歡在外面打獵，雅各則很安靜，喜歡待在家裡。
Their father Isaac loved Esau because he liked eating what Esau hunted, but Rebekah, their mother, loved Jacob.
父親以撒愛以掃，因為他喜歡吃以掃打來的野味；母親利百加卻愛雅各。
Esau had a birthright, which means he would get special things and privileges because he was the firstborn.
以掃有長子的名分，意思是他因為是頭生的，可以得到特別的東西和權利。
One day, Jacob was making a stew, and Esau came home very hungry and asked for some.
有一天，雅各在熬湯，以掃餓著肚子回家，向他要湯喝。
Jacob said he would trade Esau some stew for his birthright.
雅各說，要用湯換以掃長子的名分。
Esau agreed, and Jacob was given Esau's birthright.
以掃答應了，雅各就得了以掃長子的名分。
Later on, Isaac, their father, was getting very old, and he wanted to bless his son Esau.
後來，父親以撒年紀老邁，想要祝福兒子以掃。
Isaac's blessing was very important, and Rebekah wanted Jacob to have the blessing instead of Esau.
以撒的祝福非常重要，利百加想讓雅各、而不是以掃得到這個祝福。
So Rebekah told Jacob to pretend to be Esau and go to his father for the blessing.
利百加就叫雅各假扮成以掃，到父親那裡去領受祝福。
Isaac was turning blind, so he believed that Jacob was Esau, and he blessed him.
以撒眼睛昏花，以為雅各就是以掃，就給他祝福了。
Esau came to his father to get his blessing, but Isaac had already given it to Jacob.
以掃來向父親求祝福，但以撒已經把祝福給了雅各。
All of this made Esau hate his brother Jacob.
這一切使以掃恨他的弟弟雅各。
Esau made plans to kill his brother.
以掃打算殺掉他的弟弟。
Rebekah heard of this and had Isaac send Jacob away to live with her family.
利百加聽說了，就讓以撒打發雅各到她娘家去住。
For many years Jacob lived with his uncle and worked in the field, taking care of his flock.
雅各在舅舅那裡住了許多年，在田間工作，照顧羊群。
He started a family and gained many servants, cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats.
他成了家，又得了許多僕婢、牛、驢、綿羊和山羊。
God told Jacob to leave his uncle's land and go back to the land of his father.
神吩咐雅各離開舅舅的地，回到他父親之地去。
So Jacob took his family and everything he owned and traveled back home.
雅各就帶著家人和一切所有的，啟程回家。
Jacob knew that his brother would be there, though.
可是雅各知道哥哥會在那裡。
So he sent messengers ahead and heard that Esau had an army of four hundred men with him.
他就先打發使者去，聽說以掃帶著四百人的軍隊。
Jacob prayed to God and asked him to rescue him from Esau.
雅各向神禱告，求祂救他脫離以掃的手。
Then he sent gifts ahead of him for his brother.
That night Jacob was alone in his camp, for he had sent his family and everything he had ahead of him.
那夜雅各獨自留在營裡，因為他已經讓家人和所有的一切先過去了。
But a man came and wrestled with him until dawn.
有一個人來和他摔跤，直到黎明。
The man saw that he wouldn't win, so he touched Jacob's hip and said, "Let me go."
那人見自己勝不過他，就摸了雅各的大腿窩，說：「讓我走吧。」
But Jacob said, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."
雅各說：「你不給我祝福，我就不讓你走。」
Then the man gave Jacob a new name.
那人就給雅各一個新名字。
He said, "From now on you will be called Israel, because you have fought with God and men and have won."
他說：「從今以後你要叫以色列，因為你與神與人較力，都得了勝。」
Jacob left that place, but he had a limp because of the injury to his hip.
雅各離開那裡，但因為大腿受了傷，走路一瘸一拐。
Then Jacob looked up and saw his brother Esau coming with his four hundred men.
雅各舉目一看，見哥哥以掃帶著四百人來了。
Jacob went ahead of his family and bowed to his brother.
雅各走在家人前面，向哥哥下拜。
Esau ran to meet Jacob and hugged him. They both wept.
以掃跑來迎接雅各，抱住他，兩人都哭了。
Jacob introduced Esau to his family and gave him a gift, even though Esau said he had enough.
雅各把家人介紹給以掃，又送他禮物，雖然以掃說他已經夠了。
After everything Jacob and Esau had been through, the brothers made peace with each other.
經歷了這一切之後，兄弟倆彼此和好了。
And Jacob went on to be the father of the great nation of Israel.
雅各後來成為以色列這個大國的祖先。
